scope: Generic typed memory-color conversion; JSON mapping, private format, shared PA integration and hardware acceptance remain incomplete

retained_oem_binary.inspection: Static instructions, APS2 relocations and generic constructor constants; no execution, emulation, redistribution or private preset values

got_bindings.0x70e08: kMemColorSat at0x73db8; generic adjustment limits at+8/+12 initialized from0x15c60: float-100..100

protocol.hue_ratio: binary64 divide -> binary32 -> multiply256 -> ties-away integer -> signed16 saturation
protocol.adjustments: binary32 (clamp(x,-100,100)+100)/100-1, multiply262144/divide scaled hue extent, add+0.5 for both signs, truncate, signed16 saturation
protocol.reciprocal: binary64 65536/extent+0.5, truncate, cap32767; different from SixZone floor
protocol.blend: binary32 2^31 divided by binary32 product of three scaled extents; truncate
protocol.hue_region: For negative integer endpoints add360 once; clamp0..360 and scale1536/360; maximum low11, minimum high11
protocol.sat_val_region: binary32 clamp0..100,multiply255/divide100/truncate; maximum low8,minimum next8,scaled extent next8

retained_oem_binary.typed_interface: Semantic conversion fields only; not a binary copy of PAMemColorConfig and not a JSON-to-PAMem mapping

exact_uke_driver.scope: Native programming/ownership reference only; no writer added by this converter

upstream.scope: Inspected DSPP operations expose PCC/GC and no memory-color writer; do not infer native programming support

shared_hal.scope: 32-byte SDEPaMemColorData semantic output layout only; not proprietary input layout or exact Uke product build

pure_converter.oracle: Independent integer rational IEEE754 rounding for binary32/binary64; hand words, clamp/extents/holds/hue wrap, deterministic bit patterns and wrong-alternative differences
pure_converter.refusals: Nonfinite inputs or non-nearest rounding leave caller output unchanged

qualification.scope: Arithmetic only; no native writer, private firmware, JSON mapping or physical acceptance
